divergences.old: sde user list, project list, task list and threat list --all paging until count or an empty page, with no limit on the number of pages
divergences.toil: The same stop rule, plus a bound: after 1,000 pages (100,000 items) the command fails with HTTP, naming what was being paged, and fix text to narrow the request
divergences.why: A server that ignores the page parameter would otherwise be asked for the same page forever.

divergences.old: The sde.connection setting: one value, <token>@<host>, read from the env var or the global config file in plain text
divergences.toil: The same one value under the key connectionString (TOIL_SDE_CONNECTION_STRING), parsed the same way. An env value beats the config file. In a config file it must be a keychain: reference to the OS credential store.
divergences.why: In toil, connection names the connection a call uses (--connection, defaults.<area>.connection), so it can't also be a setting. The value holds the token, so it's a secret, and secrets never sit in a file in plain text.

divergences.old: sde task get putting the task ID into the request path as typed, so a / in it adds path segments and a ? or # is URL syntax (#86 item 1)
divergences.toil: The task ID is encoded as one path segment, so a/b is sent as tasks/a%2Fb/. Still no <project>- prefix is added (#86 item 1 stays a suspected bug)
divergences.why: An id names one resource: a task ID with path syntax in it must reach that task, or no task, never another endpoint.
